title: ficus caulobotrya var. fraseri
intro: Ficus caulobotrya var. fraseri, commonly known as the Fraser's Ficus, is a species of fig tree native to Australia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to provide relief from anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness due to its calming effects. The therapeutic actions of Ficus caulobotrya var. fraseri are attributed to its ability to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are thought to contribute to its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
